answer: Biometric Hardware Identity Stacking requires every agent to sign transactions using a unique physical processor instruction set bound to a secure enclave. If an operator deploys fake sybils crossing a fraud threshold, the hardware manufacturer revokes the cryptographic attestation root, instantly bricking the physical timber of the server rack. This drops utility to a nadir and blocks resale value. The operator absorbs capital loss on bare metal, while each malicious wallet loses access to the network without burning tokens on a digital knoll.
